body_full:
96
 Address variation policy violations
 Hello Weihai CA,
 Your parent-child relationship on Amazon.ca has been refused due to incorrect product variations. Review the affected listing and next steps below.
 Why did this happen?
 We are taking this action because we identified product variations that do not meet our variation requirements. Creating relationships between products that are fundamentally different or do not share the same core features violates our Variation relationship policy.
 To learn more about variation requirements, review our Variation relationship policy .
 How do I address this violation?
 To address this violation, click “Submit appeal” on your Account Health page .
 You'll be asked to review how your listings violated our variation requirements, confirm this violation, verify your understanding and acknowledge steps to prevent future violations.
 If you believe your parent-child relationships comply with our requirements, you can provide evidence for review. You'll be asked to explain how your child ASIN relates to the parent ASIN, confirm that you did not violate our variation requirements and optionally upload supporting documentation such as manufacturer information or product specifications.
 What happens if I do not take these actions?
 This violation will affect your Account Health Rating for 180 days from the posting date. If we receive additional complaints, we may deactivate your seller account. Deleting the listings will not remove this violation from your Account Health page. To learn more, see our Account Health Rating policy .
 We're here to help.
 For information about product variations, including guidelines for parent-child relationships and multi-pack variations, visit our Variation Policy .
 If you have questions about this policy or your account, please contact Selling Partner Support .

 Submit product safety documentation to reactivate listings
 Hello Weihai CA,
 Some of your listings have been deactivated due to missing mandatory compliance requirements for your products. Review the details and next steps below. The affected listings are shown at the end of this email.
 Why is this happening?
 We are taking this action because these products are missing mandatory compliance information. Review our Product safety and compliance help page for information on applicable laws, regulations and Amazon policies. We leveraged a combination of automated means and expert human review to identify this issue and make this decision.
 The table at the end of this email provides product-specific compliance requirements.
 How do I reactivate my listings?
 To provide the required compliance information, go to your Account Health page and locate the product compliance requests:
-
 If you have the required documentation, follow the instructions to submit your compliance documents. We will only reinstate products that fulfil the compliance requirements.
-
 If you believe your products are exempt from these requirements, submit documentation demonstrating why they are not subject to these compliance requirements.
 For step-by-step instructions, see our Submit compliance documents or appeal a documentation request help page.
 To avoid further impact to your account, close or delete any non-compliant listings that you do not intend to sell or appeal.
 What happens if I don't take these actions?
 If you don’t provide the required compliance information, the impacted ASINs will remain deactivated until the compliance requests are fulfilled by you or another selling partner listing the product.
 What happens to my FBA inventory for these products?
 You must remove these products from our fulfilment centres within 30 days of this notice. If not removed, we will dispose of the inventory at your expense as outlined in our Amazon Services Business Solutions Agreement. To learn how to remove inventory, see our Remove Inventory help page.

自 2026 年 11 月 2 日起，亚马逊在美国站点的现有商业责任险要求的基础上新增两项要求：

2.注册地位于中国大陆的卖家现在必须通过亚马逊保险加速器 (AIA) 计划购买保险。亚马逊保险加速器可为您对接一批经过预先审核的保险公司，这些保险公司了解亚马逊的承保要求，让您更容易获得合规保障、避免保单被拒，并在提出索赔时获得支持。自 2026 年 11 月 2 日起，我们将拒绝新提交但并非通过亚马逊保险加速器计划购买的保单。如果您已有一份有效的第三方保单，该保单符合承保要求，且已在 11 月 2 日之前提交给亚马逊，您可以继续使用该保单直至到期。该保单到期后，您须通过亚马逊保险加速器购买保险。
现有要求不变：根据《亚马逊服务商业解决方案协议》第 9 条，如果您在 Amazon.com 一个月的总销售收入超过 10,000 美元，或者如果亚马逊另有要求，则您必须在 30 天内投保商业责任险并续保。
自 2026 年 9 月 3 日至 2026 年 11 月 2 日，您有 60 天的合规过渡期，可用于查看更新后的要求，并确保您的保险符合这些要求。2026 年 11 月 2 日之后，不符合政策要求的商品listing将被移除。

•家用医疗器械（医用移动和转运设备、家用呼吸护理用品、助行架和轮式助行器）
•锂电池商品（锂电池、电动交通设备及其配件、锂电池供电的家用电器、锂电池供电的智能家居和消费类电子产品、便携式电源）
•户外动力和供暖设备（便携式发电机、高压清洗机、电动切割工具、燃气户外供暖商品）
•个人防护装备（安全头盔、登山头盔、攀岩安全带、攀岩绳、防坠安全带、登山锁扣）
•睡眠用品（床垫、成人活动床栏）
•运输相关商品（汽车和摩托车轮胎）
•水上和海上安全用品（可穿戴式或充气式浮力商品、泳池安全及出入控制商品）

 Automate return decisions so you're not handling each one manually.
 Put your eligible low-priced returns on autopilot.
 Managing returns one at a time doesn't scale. FBA Returnless Resolutions lets you set clear rules for when an item shouldn't be returned, and then applies them automatically, so you spend less time making case-by-case decisions.
 Streamline your returns
 A consistent, rules-based approach means predictable outcomes and less time spent firefighting individual returns. Your returns process runs the same way every time, so you can focus on growing your business.

- Deve includere la data corrente
- Deve essere consentito per il prodotto (le schede di esenzione saranno accettate solo per i prodotti privi di sostanze chimiche nocive o per i prodotti che sono, contengono o sono venduti con batterie)

96
 Recover more value from your eligible FBA returns.
 Hello,
 On October 21, 2026 , we'll expand and rename our Refurbishment and Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) Grade and Resell programs to help you recover more value from returned items.
When customers return your FBA products, some items can't be restored to new condition but can still be refurbished and resold as used. This is an opportunity to generate revenue from inventory that would otherwise be removed or disposed.
 What's changing :
- Restore to New (previously Refurbishment) : We restore eligible returned items and relist them as new.
- Sell as Used (previously FBA Grade and Resell) : We relist eligible returned items in used condition. You can enroll in one or both programs. On average, sellers enrolled in Restore to New have seen more than 70% net recovery on eligible returned items. We've also expanded Restore to New to more categories.
 How it works :
 When you enroll, we'll evaluate your returned items. If we can restore an item to new condition, we'll relist it as new and charge a processing fee of $1.50–$4.10 per unit. If we can't restore it to new but you're enrolled in Sell as Used, we'll relist it in used condition. If you're not enrolled in Sell as Used, the item will follow your unfulfillable inventory settings , and you won't be charged.
To enroll in Grade and Resell and Restore to New, go to Amazon fulfillment inventory settings .
For more information, including eligible product categories, go to the following:
- Grade and Resell value recovery settings
- Restore to New
- Sell as Used

-- Original Message --
Greetings from Fulfillment by Amazon,
I am an Amazon associate extending an invitation to you, on behalf of our research team for FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US.
Our program research team has identified you as a Seller that is not currently enrolled to our program. You may or may not potentially sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) products at this time, however you may be a Seller who would like to grow their business by starting to sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) ASIN(s) through Fulfillment By Amazon. Enrollment into the FBA Dangerous Goods Hazmat program allows sellers to continue offering/selling ASIN(s) on Fulfillment by Amazon, that have been reviewed and classified as Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) and are approved for sale through FBA.
What are dangerous goods? Dangerous goods (also called hazardous materials, or hazmat) are substances or materials that may pose a risk to health, safety, property, or the environment while storing, handling, or transporting because they contain flammable, pressurized, corrosive, or otherwise harmful substances. This may include many consumer-grade products such as perfumes, beauty products, household cleaners, and spray paints.
For more information on dangerous goods, visit our help pages in Seller Central:
- FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/help.html?itemID=ZLZBQ7W6QZRKWWK
- Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program Terms and Conditions: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GYS2KBEE7MYVCGE3
- Dangerous Goods Identification Guide: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
- Examples of Amazon Products that may be regulated as dangerous goods: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200525640
- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.
Thank you for selling with Amazon,
Mengying T.

body_full:

[Case ID:21758925371]*Your Help Needed* You’re invited to the Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US
 Greetings from Amazon,
This is a friendly reminder that we are still waiting for your feedback on our request to provide the necessary information. Please let us know if we can be of any further assistance.
-- Original Message --
Greetings from Fulfillment by Amazon,
I am an Amazon associate extending an invitation to you, on behalf of our research team for FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program US.
Our program research team has identified you as a Seller that is not currently enrolled to our program. You may or may not potentially sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) products at this time, however you may be a Seller who would like to grow their business by starting to sell Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) ASIN(s) through Fulfillment By Amazon. Enrollment into the FBA Dangerous Goods Hazmat program allows sellers to continue offering/selling ASIN(s) on Fulfillment by Amazon, that have been reviewed and classified as Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) and are approved for sale through FBA.
What are dangerous goods? Dangerous goods (also called hazardous materials, or hazmat) are substances or materials that may pose a risk to health, safety, property, or the environment while storing, handling, or transporting because they contain flammable, pressurized, corrosive, or otherwise harmful substances. This may include many consumer-grade products such as perfumes, beauty products, household cleaners, and spray paints.
For more information on dangerous goods, visit our help pages in Seller Central:
- FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/help.html?itemID=ZLZBQ7W6QZRKWWK
- Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program Terms and Conditions: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GYS2KBEE7MYVCGE3
- Dangerous Goods Identification Guide: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
- Examples of Amazon Products that may be regulated as dangerous goods: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200525640
- FBA Dangerous Goods Review Process: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201749580
You can use the look up ASIN tool at any time to check the classification status of your ASIN and whether you need to be in the FBA Dangerous Goods program to sell it. Enter your ASIN in the “Look up an ASIN” tool found by searching “Dangerous Goods” or “Hazmat” in Seller Central help, or you can access it here: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201003400
FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) FC’s are specifically designed to safely process and store DG Hazmat inventory. At this time, the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) Program is by invitation only to select participants in US. Storage is limited to FBA Seller’s enrolled to the DG Hazmat program, and that are actively utilizing their physical storage space. Utilization of a Seller’s allocated storage space is assessed regularly.
If you choose “Yes” to enroll to the program, your hazardous materials storage limit will be 10 Cubic Feet Flammable storage, and 05 Cubic Feet Aerosol storage.
Please respond by 2026-09-01 with a definitive 'YES' to accept IF you would like to enroll or 'No' if you wish to decline. Once we receive your decision to enroll, there will be no action required on your part until your enrollment to the program has been finalized. You will receive a confirmation email, when your Seller account has been enabled.
There is not an enrollment fee to join the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items that are classified and approved to be sold only through the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program require special handling and hazardous materials (hazmat) storage. Effective February 15, 2019, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) introduced separate monthly storage fees for Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program. This change will first be reflected in April 2019 charges for storage that occurs in March 2019. Monthly inventory storage fees for other products will not change. Fulfillment fees for items sold through the FBA Dangerous Goods program are in effect as of February 19, 2019.
For fee schedules, definitions, and examples for the 2019 selling fee changes, visit the pages below.
- 2019 US FBA inventory storage fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/7DQBYCMB6KE58SG
- 2019 US FBA fulfillment fee changes: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/GABBX6GZPA8MSZGW
- Inventory storage fees: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G200612770
- FBA fulfillment fees for Amazon.com orders: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/G201112670
Friendly Reminder: Only classified ASIN(s) s are permitted to continue movement throughout the Fulfillment by Amazon network. FBA Sellers are responsible to comply with all product compliance requirements, regardless if you are or are not enrolled into the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program. When listing a product that is under classification review and/or is regulated as a dangerous good (also known as Hazmat), you must provide specific product information and compliance documentation (e.g., Safety data sheet) to Amazon. Amazon uses this information to properly categorize your product, helping us ensure the safety of our customers, compliance with all applicable regulations, and that inventory in Amazon fulfillment centers is safe for storage, handling, and transportation. ASIN(s) in Unable to Classify (UTC) status will not be available for sale, and you will not be able to ship more of it to Amazon fulfillment center until classified safely. Once an ASIN is classified, you can proceed however you see fit (e.g. Inbound, Transship, Removal Orders, Disposal etc). Failure to provide this information complete and correct, may result in delays in processing your deliveries, as well as the cancellation of customer deliveries by Amazons carrier partners.
What if my items are classified as dangerous goods when I'm not enrolled in the program? You will be automatically added to the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program application waitlist. Any Amazon fulfillment center inventory that becomes classified as dangerous goods will be automatically transferred to an Amazon dangerous goods-capable fulfillment center.
Note: Transfers can take up to 14 business days. Inventory will be in “Reserved” status while in transit. Your listing will be active and sellable when the inventory has been received in the new location. Once your existing fulfillment center inventory is depleted, you will not be able to ship additional dangerous goods until you're enrolled in the FBA Dangerous Goods (Hazmat) program.
Thank you for selling with Amazon,
Mengying T.

Votre facture pour les frais de paiement au titre de la REP pour les ventes sur Amazon.fr |
Your VAT invoice for EPR Pay on Behalf charges for Amazon.fr sales
 96
 Bonjour,
Votre facture pour couvrant les frais de paiement au titre de la Responsabilité élargie du producteur (REP) pour les ventes sur Amazon.fr est désormais disponible.
La facture comprend (1) les frais d’éco-contribution qu’Amazon a payé en votre nom pour les ventes de produits soumis à des obligations REP sur Amazon.fr au cours de la période de référence applicable et (2) les frais de service REP Nous payons en votre nom, pour les catégories de REP spécifiées dans le résumé au niveau de la catégorie et dans le résumé au niveau de l’ASIN.
Pour accéder à votre facture REP Nous Payons en votre nom , ouvrez la pièce jointe de cet e-mail ou accédez à la section Factures des frais du vendeur et recherchez « REP Nous payons en votre nom » dans la colonne « Type de facture ».
Pour afficher un résumé au niveau de la catégorie des frais facturés, des périodes de déclaration applicables et des catégories REP, accédez à la section Affichage des transactions avec les frais de service comme type de transaction, et recherchez « REP Nous payons en votre nom » dans la colonne « Détails sur le produit ».
Pour afficher le détail au niveau de l’ASIN de vos frais d’éco-contribution REP, des périodes de déclaration applicables et des catégories et sous-catégories REP, consultez les Rapports sur les filières REP .
 Pourquoi ai-je été débité ?
Les producteurs doivent payer des frais d’éco-contribution aux organismes de responsabilité des producteurs (PRO) pour les ventes de produits soumis à des obligations REP sur Amazon.fr. Comme indiqué précédemment, vous avez été automatiquement inscrit au service REP Nous payons en votre nom d’Amazon, et Amazon a payé des frais d’éco-contribution pour vos ventes, car vous répondiez à tous les critères suivants :
- Vous êtes considéré comme producteur au sens du Code de l’environnement français.
- Vous avez vendu des produits soumis à des obligations REP en France sur Amazon.fr dans les catégories en vigueur.
- Vous n’avez pas soumis de numéro d’identification unique (UIN) valide pour les catégories REP en vigueur sur le portail de conformité REP avant le dernier jour du cycle de déclaration.
Pour consulter l’état de votre inscription au service REP Nous payons en votre nom et en savoir plus sur les avantages, les frais et le fonctionnement de ce service, rendez-vous sur REP Nous payons en votre nom
Si vous estimez que les frais REP Nous payons en votre nom ont été calculés de manière incorrecte, vous pouvez introduire un recours en contactant le Support partenaire de vente. Nous examinerons votre recours et prendrons les mesures nécessaires pour rembourser le montant applicable, s’il est approuvé.
L’équipe Amazon REP Nous payons en votre nom
 Hello,
Your invoice for Amazon.fr Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Pay on Behalf charges is now available.
The invoice includes (1) the eco-contribution fees that Amazon paid on your behalf for sales of products subject to EPR obligations on Amazon.fr during the applicable reporting period, and (2) EPR Pay on Behalf service fees, for the EPR categories specified in the category-level summary and the ASIN-level summary.
To access your EPR Pay on Behalf invoice , open the attachment in this email or go to Seller Fee Invoices and search for "EPR Pay on Behalf" under 'Invoice Type' column.
To see a category-level summary of the fees charged, applicable reporting periods, and EPR categories, go to Transaction View with Service Fees as Transaction type, and search for "EPR Pay on Behalf" under the 'Product Details' column.
To see an ASIN-level itemization of your EPR eco-contribution fees, applicable reporting periods, and EPR categories and sub-categories, go to EPR Category Reports .
 Why was I charged?
Producers must pay eco-contribution fees to Producer Responsibility Organizations (PROs) for sales of products subject to EPR obligations on Amazon.fr. As previously communicated, you were automatically enrolled in Amazon’s EPR Pay on Behalf, and Amazon paid eco-contribution fees for your sales, because you met all of the following criteria:
- You were considered a producer under the French Environment Code.
- You sold products subject to EPR obligations in France on Amazon.fr in the applicable categories.
- You didn’t submit a valid Unique Identification Number (UIN) for the applicable EPR categories on the EPR Compliance Portal before the last day of the reporting cycle.
To view your EPR Pay on Behalf enrolment status and learn about the service’s benefits, fees, and how it works go to EPR Pay on Behalf
If you believe that the EPR Pay on Behalf fee was calculated incorrectly, you can appeal by contacting Selling Partner Support. We’ll review your appeal and reimburse the applicable amount, if approved.
The Amazon EPR Pay on Behalf team

 Cómo seguir vendiendo estos productos
 Asegúrate de que la ficha de datos de seguridad cumple los siguientes requisitos:

- Incluir información de identificación de peligro SAM o CLP, según la última versión de la normativa
- Incluir las 16 secciones que conforman una ficha de datos de seguridad estándar
- Coincidir con el título del listing (también se conoce como nombre del producto), tal y como aparece en la página de detalles del producto
- Coincidir con el fabricante o el nombre de la marca que aparece en la página de detalles del producto
 Procura que la ficha de exención cumpla con los siguientes requisitos:
- Coincidir con el título del listing (también se conoce como nombre del producto), tal y como aparece en la página de detalles del producto
- Incluye tu nombre completo (nombre y apellidos).
- Incluye la fecha actual.
- Está permitida para tu producto (las fichas de exención sólo se aceptarán para productos sin químicos dañinos o que sean, contengan o se vendan con pilas o baterías).

 Una vez que el documento (FDS o la ficha de exención) esté listo, envíalo a través de la página de carga de Seller Central.

Recibirás una notificación con nuestra decisión cuando hayamos concluido la revisión. Recuerda asegurarte de que el nombre, la descripción del producto y la lista de características describan de forma adecuada y completa al producto en revisión, y de detallar claramente todos los artículos que se venden con él (por ejemplo, un televisor y el control remoto).

È possibile presentare una scheda di esenzione solo se il prodotto non dispone di una scheda di sicurezza e non contiene sostanze chimiche nocive, come alcol, acido, sodio e così via, o se il prodotto è, contiene o viene venduto con batterie.
 Cosa fare per continuare a vendere questi prodotti
 Si assicuri che la SDS sia conforme ai seguenti requisiti:
- Deve essere stata creata o aggiornata negli ultimi cinque anni.
- Deve includere nuove informazioni di identificazione di pericolo GHS/CLP.
- Deve includere tutte le 16 sezioni standard della SDS.
- Deve corrispondere al titolo dell'offerta (indicato anche come nome del prodotto) così come appare nella pagina prodotto.
- Deve includere il nome del produttore o del marchio visualizzato nella pagina prodotto.
 Assicurati che la scheda di esenzione sia conforme ai seguenti requisiti:
- Deve corrispondere al titolo dell'offerta (indicato anche come nome del prodotto) così come appare nella pagina prodotto
- Deve includere il nome completo (nome e cognome)
- Deve includere la data corrente
- Deve essere consentito per il prodotto (le schede di esenzione saranno accettate solo per i prodotti privi di sostanze chimiche nocive o per i prodotti che sono, contengono o sono venduti con batterie)

subject: OPR 体验优化——无需再手动追踪货件  /  Improvement to Your OPR Experience — No More Manual Shipment Tracking
body_preview:
尊敬的 Crifeton 团队：
我们很高兴地通知您，OPR（Operational Performance Review运营表现评估）流程迎来一项优化，这将使开启 OPR 变得更加简单，并且您无需再手动追踪货件。
变更内容：亚马逊的系统现在会自动识别在您开启 OPR 之前发出的货件，并将其从 OPR 扫描评估范围中排除。这意味着您不再需要等待所有未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存全部到达亚马逊运营中心后，再开启 OPR。
这对您意味着什么?
  1.  准备就绪（从现在开始所有商品都将正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签）即可开启 OPR，无需再等待在途未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件全部入仓后再开启。
  2.  无需再人工追踪未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件的入仓时间。
  3.  您的 OPR 绩效数据将更加准确，因为仅包含应用了 Transparency 透明计划标签的产品的扫描结果。
  4.  更快、更顺畅地让您的产品获得 Transparency 透明计划保护。
您需要做什么？ 您的操作流程无需任何更改。请在您确保未来发出的货件（包括此前已创建但尚未发出的货件）都会正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签时，即可开启 OPR。
若您需要帮助：请联系您的 Transparency 透明计划经理或客户管理团队协助。
常见问题
Q1: OPR 扫描有哪些变化？
亚马逊推出了货件感知处理流程（Shipment-Aware Processing），这是一项自动化流程旨在让您的 OPR 开启变得更加简单。在过去您需要谨慎考虑开启 OPR 的时间，以避免（已在途的）未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存在亚马逊运营中心扫描时失败，从而影响您的运营表现评估的结果。而现在我们的系统会自动追踪您的货件日期，只扫描在您开启 OPR 之后发出的货件。任何在开启之前已经在途的库存都不会被扫描。
Q2: 我需要有哪些不同的操作？
您的操作流程无需更改。如果您能确保未来发出的货件（包括此前已创建但尚未发出的货件）都会正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签时，那么就可以开启 OPR。您不再需要等待所有未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存全部被亚马逊运营中心接收后再开启 OPR，系统会自动处理这一切。
Q3: 我现有的未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存会导致扫码失败吗？
不会。任何在您开启 OPR 之前发出的货件都会被扫描系统自动跳过。只有在您 OPR 开启日期之后发出的货件才会进行运营表现评估。
Q4: 这会影响 OPR 通过（Graduation）的时间吗？
不会。此项变更旨在优化您的 OPR 体验，消除 OPR 开启前库存因缺失 Trans

  1.  准备就绪（从现在开始所有商品都将正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签）即可开启 OPR，无需再等待在途未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件全部入仓后再开启。
  2.  无需再人工追踪未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签货件的入仓时间。

常见问题
Q1: OPR 扫描有哪些变化？
亚马逊推出了货件感知处理流程（Shipment-Aware Processing），这是一项自动化流程旨在让您的 OPR 开启变得更加简单。在过去您需要谨慎考虑开启 OPR 的时间，以避免（已在途的）未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存在亚马逊运营中心扫描时失败，从而影响您的运营表现评估的结果。而现在我们的系统会自动追踪您的货件日期，只扫描在您开启 OPR 之后发出的货件。任何在开启之前已经在途的库存都不会被扫描。
Q2: 我需要有哪些不同的操作？
您的操作流程无需更改。如果您能确保未来发出的货件（包括此前已创建但尚未发出的货件）都会正确应用 Transparency 透明计划标签时，那么就可以开启 OPR。您不再需要等待所有未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存全部被亚马逊运营中心接收后再开启 OPR，系统会自动处理这一切。
Q3: 我现有的未应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的库存会导致扫码失败吗？
不会。任何在您开启 OPR 之前发出的货件都会被扫描系统自动跳过。只有在您 OPR 开启日期之后发出的货件才会进行运营表现评估。
Q4: 这会影响 OPR 通过（Graduation）的时间吗？
不会。此项变更旨在优化您的 OPR 体验，消除 OPR 开启前库存因缺失 Transparency 透明计划标签而导致的扫描失败。您的 OPR 运营表现评估的指标将更加准确，因为它只会记录已应用 Transparency 透明计划标签的货件的贴标正确率。
Q5: 我还需要手动追踪我的货件到达亚马逊运营中心的状态吗？
不需要。系统现在会根据货件发出时间与您 OPR 开启日期的先后关系，自动判断哪些货件应被扫描，只有在 OPR 开启后发出的货件才会进行运营表现评估。您不再需要手动追踪货件到达亚马逊运营中心的状态。
Q6: 所有站点都可以使用此流程吗？
可以。货件感知处理流程（Shipment-Aware Processing）适用于所有已启用 Transparency 透明计划 OPR 的站点。（美加日印澳，英法德意西）
谢谢，
Transparency 透明计划团队

Dear Crifeton Team,
We are excited to share an improvement to the OPR (Operational Performance Review) process that makes activating OPR simpler and eliminates the need for manual shipment tracking.
What's changing: Our system now automatically identifies shipments that were sent before you activated OPR and skips them from scanning. This means you no longer need to wait for all unlabeled inventory to arrive at fulfillment centers before turning on OPR.
What this means for you:
  1.  Turn on OPR whenever you are ready, no need to time it around in-transit shipments
  2.  No more manual spreadsheet tracking of shipment dates
  3.  Your OPR metrics will be more accurate, reflecting only shipments that contain labeled products
  4.  Faster, smoother path to Protection
What you need to do: Nothing changes in your process. Continue to activate OPR when you begin labeling all your products with Transparency codes and have shipped all unlabeled shipments.
Need help? If you need support, please contact your Account Manager or Account Management Team for assistance.
Frequently asked questions:
Q1: What is changing with OPR scanning?
We are introducing Shipment-Aware Processing, an automated improvement that makes OPR activation simpler for you. Previously, you needed to carefully time when to turn on OPR to avoid unlabeled inventory (already in transit) from failing scans at fulfillment centers. Now, our system automatically tracks your shipment dates and only scans shipments that were shipped after you activate OPR. Any inventory already in transit before activation will not be scanned.
Q2: What do I need to do differently?
Nothing changes in your process. Continue to turn on OPR when you begin labeling your products with Transparency codes. You no longer need to wait for all unlabeled inventory to arrive before activating OPR, the system handles this automatically.
Q3: Will my existing unlabeled shipments fail scans?
No. Any shipments that were shipped before you activated OPR will be automatically skipped by the scanning system. Only shipments shipped after your OPR activation date will be scanned.
Q4: Does this affect my OPR graduation timeline?
No. This change is designed to improve your OPR experience by removing false failures from pre-activation inventory. Your OPR graduation metrics will be more accurate because they will only reflect shipments that should contain labeled products.
Q5: Do I still need to track my shipments manually?
No. The system now automatically determines which shipments should be scanned based on when they were shipped relative to your OPR activation date. You no longer need to maintain spreadsheets or manually track shipment timing.
Q6: Is this available in all marketplaces?
Yes. Shipment-Aware Processing applies across all marketplaces where Transparency OPR is active.
Thank you for being a Transparency partner.
Best regards,
Transparency Team

Produkten framställs via sin förpackning, visning, marknadsföring eller reklam som lämplig för användning av ett barn som är 14 år eller yngre.
Produkten uppfattas allmänt av konsumenter som avsedd att användas av ett barn som är 14 år eller yngre.

 Soumettre la documentation de sécurité des produits pour réactiver les mises en vente
 Bonjour Weihai EU,
 Certaines de vos mises en vente ont été désactivées, car vos produits ne respectaient pas des exigences de conformité obligatoires. Consultez les détails et les étapes suivantes ci-dessous. Les produits mis en vente concernés figurent à la fin de cet e-mail.
 Pourquoi cela se produit-il ?
 Nous prenons cette mesure, car ces produits ne présentent pas les informations de conformité obligatoires. Consultez notre page d’aide Sécurité et conformité des produits pour obtenir des informations sur les lois, réglementations et politiques Amazon applicables. Nous nous sommes appuyés sur une combinaison de moyens automatisés et de contrôles menés par des personnes expérimentées pour identifier ce problème et prendre cette décision.
 Le tableau situé à la fin de cet e-mail présente les exigences de conformité spécifiques aux produits.
 Comment réactiver mes produits mis en vente ?
 Pour fournir les informations de conformité requises, accédez à la page État du compte et localisez les demandes de conformité des produits :
-
 Si vous disposez des documents requis, suivez les instructions pour soumettre vos documents de conformité. Nous rétablirons uniquement les produits répondant aux exigences de conformité.
-
 Si vous pensez que vos produits sont exemptés de ces exigences, soumettez des pièces justificatives prouvant les raisons pour lesquelles ils ne sont pas soumis à ces exigences de conformité.
 Pour des instructions détaillées, consultez la page d’aide Soumettre des documents de conformité ou contester une demande de documents .
 Pour éviter toute perturbation supplémentaire de votre compte, clôturez ou supprimez tous les produits mis en vente non conformes que vous n’avez pas l’intention de vendre ou de contester.
 Que se passe-t-il si je ne prends pas ces mesures ?
 Si vous ne fournissez pas les informations de conformité requises, les ASIN concernés resteront désactivés jusqu’à ce que les demandes de conformité soient traitées par vous ou un autre partenaire de vente ayant mis en vente le produit.
 Que va-t-il advenir du stock Expédié par Amazon de ces produits ?
 Vous devez prélever ces produits de nos centres de distribution dans les 30 jours suivant cette notification. Si ce n’est pas le cas, nous procèderons à la mise au rebut du stock à vos frais, comme stipulé dans notre Contrat Amazon Services Business Solutions. Découvrez comment prélever du stock sur la page d’aide Prélever du stock .
 Nous sommes là pour vous aider.
 Pour en savoir plus, regardez notre vidéo Introduction à la sécurité et à la conformité sur Seller University
 Si vous avez d’autres questions, soumettez une demande dans votre Tableau de bord, dans l’onglet État du compte .

 Hoe activeer ik mijn productvermeldingen opnieuw?
 Als je de vereiste nalevingsgegevens wilt verstrekken, ga je naar de pagina Accountstatus en zoek je de aanvragen voor productconformiteit:
-
 Als je over de vereiste documentatie beschikt, volg je de instructies om je nalevingsdocumenten in te dienen. We zullen alleen producten herstellen die voldoen aan de nalevingsvereisten.
-

 Raadpleeg voor stapsgewijze instructies onze hulp-pagina Documenten voor naleving indienen of in beroep gaan tegen een documentatieverzoek .
 Om verdere impact op je account te voorkomen, sluit of verwijder je alle niet-conforme productvermeldingen die je niet van plan bent te verkopen of waartegen je niet in beroep denkt te gaan.
 Wat gebeurt er als ik deze acties niet onderneem?

 Wat gebeurt er met mijn FBA-voorraad voor deze producten?
 Je moet deze producten binnen 30 dagen na deze kennisgeving uit onze fulfillment centers verwijderen. Indien deze niet worden verwijderd, zullen wij de voorraad op jouw kosten verwijderen zoals beschreven in onze Amazon Services Business Solutions-overeenkomst. Meer informatie over het verwijderen van voorraad vind je op de hulp-pagina Voorraad verwijderen .

Kinderspeelgoed verwijst naar een product dat bedoeld is voor kinderen van 14 jaar of jonger om mee te spelen of te leren.

subject: New Insurance requirements effective Nov 2, 2026
body_preview:

 Important updates to commercial liability insurance requirements — new category-based requirements and AIA mandate for China-based sellers effective November 2, 2026.
 Hello,
 Effective November 2, 2026, we’re updating our commercial liability insurance requirements to help protect Amazon’s customers as well as help you protect your business from financial loss in the event of a product-related incident.
 Our existing policy requires all sellers to obtain and maintain commercial liability insurance within 30 days if gross proceeds from Amazon.com sales exceed USD 10,000 in any month, with minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in the aggregate. While these requirements remain, we are introducing two additional requirements.
 First, sellers with products listed in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements will now be required to maintain a commercial liability insurance policy that covers those products, with a minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in aggregate, regardless of whether they meet the USD 10,000 gross proceeds in a month threshold.  Important updates to commercial liability insurance requirements — new category-based requirements and AIA mandate for China-based sellers effective November 2, 2026.
 Hello,
 Effective November 2, 2026, we’re updating our commercial liability insurance requirements to help protect Amazon’s customers as well as help you protect your business from financial loss in the event of a product-related incident.
 Our existing policy requires all sellers to obtain and maintain commercial liability insurance within 30 days if gross proceeds from Amazon.com sales exceed USD 10,000 in any month, with minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in the aggregate. While these requirements remain, we are introducing two additional requirements.
 First, sellers with products listed in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements will now be required to maintain a commercial liability insurance policy that covers those products, with a minimum coverage of USD 1 million per occurrence and in aggregate, regardless of whether they meet the USD 10,000 gross proceeds in a month threshold. This change applies to both new and existing listings.
 Product categories with enhanced safety listing requirements include, but are not limited to, children’s products, cosmetic and ingestible products, and lithium battery products. For the full list of categories impacted by these changes, go to Product categories with enhanced safety listing requirements .
 Second, sellers based in Mainland China must now obtain their insurance through the Amazon Insurance Accelerator (AIA) program. AIA connects you with a network of pre-vetted insurers who understand Amazon's coverage requirements, making it easier to secure compliant coverage, avoid policy rejections, and ensure your claims are supported when they arise. Starting November 2, 2026, we will reject newly submitted insurance policies that are not obtained through AIA. If you have a valid third-party insurance policy that meets the coverage requirements and was submitted to Amazon before November 2, you can continue using it until it expires. After that policy expires, you will be required to obtain insurance through AIA.
 If we determine that you require new or updated commercial liability insurance based on the categories that you sell in, you’ll receive an email from us requesting that you provide proof of insurance within 45 days of that notification. The email will include resources for obtaining coverage and instructions for submitting your documentation.
 These changes will take effect starting November 2, 2026. If you don’t submit required proof of commercial liability insurance, your listings in categories with enhanced safety listing requirements may be deactivated until you provide compliant documentation. Your listings in other categories will not be impacted.
 The updated Commercial Liability Insurance requirements page reflects these changes. For more information, go to the ‘frequently asked questions’ section on the Business Insurance page.

 为什么会发生这种情况？
 我们之所以采取此措施，是因为这些商品缺少必要的合规信息。请查看我们的 商品安全与合规 帮助页面，了解有关适用法律法规和亚马逊政策的信息。为了确定此问题，我们综合运用了自动化技术和专家人工评审，最终做出这一决定。
 此电子邮件末尾的表格提供了特定于商品的合规性要求。
 如何重新启售商品？
 要提供所需的合规信息，请前往 账户状况 页面并找到商品合规性请求：
-
 如果您有所需的文件，请按照相关说明提交您的合规文件。我们仅会重新启售满足合规要求的商品。
-
 如果您认为您的商品无需遵守这些要求，请提交相关文件，说明它们为何不受这些合规要求的约束。

-
 Jeśli uważasz, że Twoje produkty są zwolnione z wymogów dotyczących zgodności, prześlij dokumentację wskazującą przyczynę, dla której nie podlegają one tym wymogom.

 Musisz wycofać zapasy tych produktów z centrów logistycznych w ciągu 30 dni od tego powiadomienia.  Why this is happening
 We do not have enough dangerous goods information to correctly classify the above products, and until you provide the necessary information, the products will not be available for sale and you will not be able to send more units to Amazon fulfillment centers. We need you to provide a proper Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each product listed above. You may submit an exemption sheet only if the product does not have an SDS and does not contain any harmful chemicals, such as alcohol, acid, sodium, etc., or if the product is, contains, or is sold with batteries.
 How to continue selling these products
 Please make sure the SDS complies with the following requirements:
- Created or updated within the last five years
- Include new GHS / CLP hazard identification information
- Includes all 16 standard SDS sections
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Matches the manufacturer or brand name displayed on the product detail page
 Please make sure the exemption sheet complies with the following requirements:
- Matches the listing title (also referred to as the product name) as it appears on the product detail page
- Includes your full name (first and last)
- Includes the current date
- Is allowed for your product (exemption sheets will only be accepted for products without harmful chemicals or products that are, contain, or are sold with batteries)
- Contains all required information (ensure all red cells are filled in and black cells are left blank)
 Important : Complete instructions on how to fill out the exemption sheet are available in the template itself within the Instructions tab.
 Once your document (SDS or exemption sheet) is ready, please submit it through the Seller Central upload page .
 When the proper information has been provided, the review process generally takes four business days. You will receive a notification of the results when the review is complete. As a friendly reminder, please make sure the title, product description and bullet points adequately and fully describe the product under review, and clearly list out all items sold with it (for example, a TV and its remote).
 For more information on SDS and exemption sheets, refer to Required dangerous good information and documentation .
 All sellers are responsible for ensuring that products sent to Amazon fulfillment centers comply with FBA policies and any legal requirements regarding dangerous goods, even if they are not currently restricted by FBA.
 Helpful information
 For more information, see the Dangerous goods identification guide .
 Thank you,
 The Fulfillment by Amazon team

 CSBA Insights Dashboard
 Get the most out of Customer Service by Amazon
 Use the CSBA Insights dashboard in Seller Central to:
- Review customer service contacts handled by Amazon
- Find ways to improve customer experience
- Reduce contact and return rates
 Follow these practices to prevent customer confusion and minimize your workload:
- Monitor the Response Needed inbox within the Buyer-Seller Messaging Service . In the rare case that we need your help to resolve a customer issue, we'll summarize the conversation and pass the contact to you. You're expected to answer within 24 hours to ensure a great customer experience. You’ll still be responsible for pre-order inquiries.
- Avoid initiating 1:1 contact with customers. If you reach out to customers directly, Amazon can no longer support the customer regarding that order and you'll have to take responsibility for the rest of the conversation.
- Provide valid tracking. Include a valid tracking number with every shipment. This is the best way to prevent customers from contacting customer service.
- Improve product descriptions based on refunds. More accurate product descriptions can help manage customer expectations.
- Was a customer issued a refund incorrectly? If Amazon issues a refund and you don't think that you should be held financially responsible, do not contact the customer. Instead, file a claim for reimbursement via Seller Assurance for E-Commerce Transactions (SAFE-T). Learn more about SAFE-T claim eligibility and filing processes .

- CPU rate is only calculated based on post-order contacts that Amazon handles on your behalf
